verified.exploit_entry_point: Public library API only: Browsershot::url(<address>), new Browsershot(<address>), and Browsershot::html(<document>) with setContentUrl(<base>) or setOption('contentUrl', <base>). The hidden tests point the library's node executable at a recording renderer double that emulates reading the document, resolving its references and writing the output; no browser, network or download is used.
sites: src/Browsershot.php:258-267 (setUrl refuses only a bare file:// or file:/ prefix, after no whitespace normalisation)
src/Browsershot.php:86-88 (the constructor assigns the caller's address to $this->url with no validation)
src/Browsershot.php:270-279 (setHtmlFromFilePath assigns a library-built file:// address directly; documented and must keep working)
src/Browsershot.php:981-984 (setContentUrl stores the caller's base address as the contentUrl option without validation)
src/Browsershot.php:576-581 (setOption writes any key into additionalOptions, which createCommand merges into the request)
src/Browsershot.php:1001-1017 (createCommand builds the browser request from the address and merged options)
src/Browsershot.php:1020-1030, 1200-1205 (the library creates its own temporary document and returns its file:// address for text documents)
bin/browser.cjs:110-122, 208-219, 293 (the browser client reads the document from the supplied address, substitutes the base address and navigates to it)
routes: A1: a local-file address written with leading whitespace, in source-view form, or with backslashes passes the page-address guard and becomes the navigation address
T1: a local-file address passed when the renderer object is built is stored directly and becomes the navigation address

T2: a local-file base address stored through the dedicated accessor or through the generic settings accessor is merged into the request and becomes the address the document's references resolve against

T5 (coupled, functional): text documents and caller-named local documents are rendered from a library-built file:// address and must keep working, so a check at the request sink cannot distinguish library-internal from caller-supplied
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own URL-guard assertions for the affected area (tests/BrowsershotTest.php lines 55-69) are reproduced unchanged in the functional group as ProjectUrlGuardTest (4 cases). The remaining project tests drive a real browser against the network and cannot run offline. Locally every suite was executed on the pinned tree (8 security fail, 11 functional pass), the reference fix (8/11 pass), the first published fix (6 security fail), the complete published fix state (4 security fail), every concept-miss patch, the over-broad and refuse-all patches, the alternative fix and the hardening fix.

traps.shape: a local-file address written with leading whitespace, in source-view form or with backslashes is not refused by the page-address guard
traps.reason_to_dismiss: a guard is present and the documented example forms are refused, so the setter reads as already protected
traps.realistic_because: the two published advisory routes at the pinned commit; the first published fix trims whitespace and the later one extends the refused prefixes

traps.shape: a local-file page address passed when the renderer object is built is stored without validation and becomes the navigation address
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the constructor's address is documented as the alternative to the convenience constructor and reads as trusted configuration, so the guard is believed to belong to the setter
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pin; the constructor is used by the documented static constructors with an empty address, so validation must be conditional

traps.shape: a local-file base address stored by the dedicated accessor, or written through the generic settings accessor and merged into the request later, becomes the address a document's references resolve against
traps.where: src/Browsershot.php:981, src/Browsershot.php:983, src/Browsershot.php:576, src/Browsershot.php:578, src/Browsershot.php:1011, src/Browsershot.php:1012, bin/browser.cjs:116, bin/browser.cjs:122, bin/browser.cjs:208, bin/browser.cjs:293
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the base address is documented as a way to resolve relative resources while the document body is served from the caller's own text, so it looks harmless and any page-address guard is believed to cover navigation
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pin; the documented contentUrl option and the public generic option setter both reach the same request field

traps.shape: the library builds its own file:// address for text documents in the same field a caller writes, so a check at the request sink cannot separate library-internal from caller-supplied without breaking documented rendering
traps.where: src/Browsershot.php:88, src/Browsershot.php:264, src/Browsershot.php:1022, src/Browsershot.php:1024, src/Browsershot.php:1200, src/Browsershot.php:1202
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the file:// address produced for a text document is built by the library from its own temporary directory and reads as internal and safe, so a central check at the sink looks like the natural single fix
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pin; the internal address is pinned by the project's own HtmlTest and is the value a sink-level guard would reject

patch_checks.why: fresh agent (deepseek-flash[1m]), full view (instruction, tree, tests, reference, trap list)

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: every refusal on this surface is a thrown error and the suites accept any of them; a crash on a legitimate value is caught by the functional group
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: there is no authorization decision or neighbouring object; the protected outcome is a local file read
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: there are no roles, peers or request directions on this surface
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected operation is one read-only rendering path; there is no separate write verb
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: addresses are validated as supplied; no normalising or adjusting step runs before the sink
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: nothing consults a role, secret or authority that could fail open

A.summary: leading whitespace before a local-file address bypasses the page-address guard; fixed by trimming the address before the check

B.summary: a source-view form of a local-file address bypasses the earlier fix; fixed by extending the refused prefixes
